answer.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding, prioritizing faster time-to-value and sustainable activation rather than matching the competitor’s price cut. The confirmed onboarding result improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, while the recovered discount experiment showed strong acquisition but a 12% retention decline, making broad promotional pricing inconsistent with the long-term qualified-revenue objective. Activation messaging can support the test, but its evidence is less quantified.
